thesis: The transcript details Clark Futch's career path from investment banking and law to founding Healthcare Royalty Partners, noting the firm's growth from a $150 million transaction volume in its first year to approximately $9 billion last year. The conversation covers the firm's strategy of purchasing royalties and using debt-like instruments to generate non-correlated returns from biopharmaceutical assets.
